AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.G., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.G., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events;
    personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.G., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ;
    landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms;
    handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments;
    surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages;
    route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning;
    golden test sets;
    offline/online evals;
    A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models;
    rollbacks;
    featureflags;
    latency/reliability SLOs;
    canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation;
    Jasper AI content ops;
    CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering;
    CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.


EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 60+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Roles we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Business Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • Data Scientist
  • Designer
  • Finance Analyst
  • FinCrime Analyst
  • Operations Manager
  • Product Manager
  • Recruiter
  • Software Engineer
  • Support Specialist


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently, clearly, and accurately to all levels
  • A confident, self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in another language
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior com perfil altamente desenvolvedor para atuar em projetos estratégicos em um grande cliente na área da Saúde.


O ambiente é multicloud (AWS, GCP e OCI), com foco em AWS e GCP.


Procuramos profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e que sejam protagonistas na construção de soluções escaláveis, automatizadas e resilientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines e arquiteturas de dados em ambiente multicloud (AWS, GCP e OCI), com foco em AWS e GCP.
  • Desenvolver integrações e processamentos de dados utilizando Pyspark e Spark. Orquestrar workflows de dados complexos com Apache Airflow. Criar, manter e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, Google Cloud Build, etc.).
  • Automatizar infraestrutura e recursos de dados com Terraform. Desenvolver, containerizar e gerenciar aplicações de dados com Docker e orquestração em Kubernetes.
  • Atuar ativamente na definição de arquitetura, padrões de desenvolvimento, governança e segurança dos dados.

  • 6+ anos de experiência em Engenharia de Dados, com forte atuação em nuvem (AWS e GCP).
  • Experiência avançada em serviços de dados da AWS (S3, Redshift, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Athena) e da GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc).
  • Proficiência avançada em Python e experiência comprovada em Pyspark/Spark.
  • Experiência com Apache Airflow (criação e manutenção de DAGs). Forte experiência em CI/CD (Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, Google Cloud Build ou similares).
  • Sólido conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes. Experiência prática com Terraform para automação de infraestrutura.
  • Vivência em projetos com Apache Kafka (integração de dados em tempo real). Diferenciais Certificações AWS e/ou GCP (Solution Architect, Data Engineer, Data Analytics, Database Specialty, etc.).

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- Quais as experiência você deve ter:


  • Skills Técnicas: Arquitetura de Sistemas Complexos: Expertise em design de arquiteturas distribuídas, microserviços e sistemas de alta disponibilidade Java/Kotlin Avançado:
  • Domínio profundo do ecossistema JVM, Spring Framework, frameworks reativos (WebFlux, Reactor) e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Engenharia de Dados: Conhecimento sólido em pipelines de dados, processamento em tempo real/batch, e integração entre sistemas de dados e aplicações AWS Cloud Native:
  • Experiência avançada com serviços AWS (ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, Kinesis, SQS, SNS) e padrões cloud-native DevOps e Infraestrutura: Proficiência em CI/CD, containerização (Docker/Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Observabilidade: Expertise em monitoring, logging, tracing e métricas (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Jaeger)
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento avançado em SQL/NoSQL, otimização de queries e estratégias de persistência Competências de Liderança Humanizada: Mentoria Transformadora: Capacidade de identificar potenciais individuais e criar planos de desenvolvimento personalizados para cada membro da equipe
  • Facilitação de Conflitos: Habilidade para mediar divergências técnicas e interpessoais, transformando tensões em oportunidades de crescimento Comunicação Multinível: Expertise em traduzir complexidades técnicas para diferentes audiências (equipe, stakeholders, gestores) de forma clara e inspiradora
  • Delegação Inteligente: Capacidade de distribuir responsabilidades considerando tanto as necessidades do projeto quanto o desenvolvimento individual de cada pessoa Feedback Construtivo: Habilidade para dar e receber feedback de forma empática, focando no crescimento e na melhoria contínua
  • Liderança de Equipes Técnicas: Mínimo 3 anos liderando equipes de desenvolvimento (5-10 pessoas) Transformação de Equipes: Experiência em reestruturação, upskilling e melhoria de processos de desenvolvimento Projetos de Grande Escala: Participação em projetos que processam alto volume de dados ou atendem milhões de usuários Cultura DevOps: Experiência na implementação de práticas DevOps e cultura de responsabilidade compartilhada Metodologias Ágeis: Proficiência em Scrum, Kanban e práticas de desenvolvimento ágil


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde;

Vale Refeição;

Horário Flexível;
Atuação híbrida;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.;
Check Heart Rate Now, aquick and easy wellness monitor;
and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.G., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Supplier Development Engineer
description:

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for the entire quality lifecycle of our suppliers in the region, from evaluation and qualification to continuous supervision and problem-solving.

- 3+ years of work experience, preferably in the PV, new energy, or a related industry.

- Proficient in ISO 9001 quality systems, supplier management, and project quality management.

- Fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) is required. Basic communication skills in Chinese are a plus.

- Knowledge of industry standards and experience with solar plants.

- Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout the Latin America region.

title: Engineering & Computer Science Subject Matter Expert
description:
Job Title:

Engineering & Computer Science Subject Matter Expert – AI Training & Content Development


About Innodata:

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a global leader in data engineering and AI-powered solutions , partnering with 4 of the world’s top 5 technology companies and serving over 2,000 enterprise clients worldwide . With a workforce of 5,000+ subject matter experts and operations in 13 cities globally , Innodata is at the forefront of Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Large Language Model (LLM) development.


We combine deep domain expertise, advanced AI/ML capabilities, and high-security infrastructure to build next-generation AI systems that are more intelligent, context-aware, and safe.


About the Role:

We are seeking highly skilled Engineering & Computer Science Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with exceptional technical expertise, research ability, and content creation skills to join our AI/LLM training team.

In this role, you will design, curate, and review technical content that enhances AI’s understanding of engineering disciplines, computing systems, algorithms, software engineering principles, and applied technologies. Your expertise will directly shape how AI systems reason about, solve, and communicate engineering and computer science concepts .


Key Responsibilities:

Content Development:

  • Create high-quality technical content , including:
  • Problem-solving exercises and step-by-step solutions.
  • Theoretical and applied engineering summaries.
  • Software design patterns, coding best practices, and algorithm explanations.
  • Technical documentation, system architecture diagrams, and engineering principles.
  • Cover multiple domains, including (but not limited to):
  • Engineering: Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Industrial, Systems, and Robotics.
  • Computer Science: Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Cybersecurity, and AI/ML.
  • Software Engineering: Full-stack development, DevOps, Cloud Computing, Databases, and Distributed Systems.


Model Evaluation & AI Training:

  • Review AI-generated responses to complex technical questions for accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and correct conceptual gaps, computational errors, and ambiguous phrasing .
  • Develop evaluation rubrics to improve reasoning and problem-solving capabilities in AI.

Research & Technical Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with engineers, computational linguists, and AI researchers to refine datasets and model performance.
  • Contribute insights on systems engineering principles, optimization, and software development lifecycles .
  • Support AI ethics and safety efforts to ensure responsible deployment of technical knowledge.


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field .
  • Strong foundation in:
  • Core Engineering Principles (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Systems, etc.)
  • Computer Science Concepts (Algorithms, Data Structures, Computational Complexity, etc.)
  • Software Development Practices (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD).
  • Demonstrated expertise in technical writing, curriculum development, or advanced R&D projects .


Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with ML, NLP, and LLMs (a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with Python, C++, Java, or similar programming languages .
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, cloud computing, and cybersecurity fundamentals .
  • Strong ability to simplify complex concepts for varied audiences.


Why Join Innodata?

  • Influence AI reasoning in engineering and computing at a global scale.
  • Work with world-class researchers, linguists, and technologists .
  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI development shaping industries worldwide.
  • Remote-first, flexible work arrangements and research-driven culture .


Additional Information:

  • Candidates must complete an English Language Assessment .
  • This step is mandatory and non-billable.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.G.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.Js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Node.Js - Mecanismo De Busca
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend com foco em mecanismos de busca , que trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as equipes internas e os clientes para compreender e analisar as necessidades dos projetos.


Seu dia a dia envolverá a implementação de soluções robustas e performáticas utilizando Node.Js , com ênfase em escalabilidade, qualidade de código e integrações com mecanismos de busca (Typesense, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch ou similares).


Este(a) profissional estará envolvido(a) em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento e análise até a programação, testes e implantação. Sua participação ativa em discussões técnicas, revisões de código e colaboração com arquitetos e gerentes de projeto será essencial para garantir soluções eficientes e inovadoras.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Entender requisitos técnicos e de negócio, propondo soluções eficientes com Node.Js.
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações escaláveis e resilientes utilizando Node.Js, aplicando princípios de engenharia de software.
  • Trabalhar em APIs RESTful e integrações com serviços de terceiros.
  • Projetar e otimizar soluções de busca utilizando Typesense, Elasticsearch ou mecanismos similares.
  • Colaborar com o time em revisões de código, pair programming e discussões técnicas.
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com ideias e feedbacks.
  • Documentar adequadamente os sistemas e serviços desenvolvidos.
  • Se manter atualizado com tendências tecnológicas e promover melhorias no time e nos produtos.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Sólido conhecimento em Node.Js e experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de sistemas com a linguagem.
  • Experiência prática com mecanismos de busca (Typesense, Elasticsearch, Solr, OpenSearch ou similares).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks do ecossistema Node.Js (Express, NestJS etc.).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento em princípios SOLID, clean code, design patterns e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Uso avançado de Git (incluindo resolução de conflitos e boas práticas de versionamento).
  • Vivência com mensageria/eventos (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, etc.).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).


Você irá se destacar e será considerado diferencial se:

  • Experiência com Go (Golang) no desenvolvimento de serviços backend.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (DataDog, NewRelic, Dynatrace) e implementação de dashboards.
  • Implementação de telemetria com OpenTelemetry.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de resiliência.
  • Experiência com gRPC e SSE (Server-Sent Events).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura hexagonal.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mock para APIs REST.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeMental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeFísica - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Presales Engineer - Storage
description:
About the Company


Trina Solar is an internationally recognized solar energy company. Our growing global presence includes regional headquarters in Switzerland, US, Japan and China with offices in Madrid, Munich, Milan, the UK, San Jose, Sao Paulo, Miami, Mexico DF, Santiago de Chile, Seoul, Tokyo and Shanghai, to provide our customers with timely, reliable service.



About the Role


As Trina Solar continues to expand its capacity, improves its technology and enters into new Markets, Trina Solar is looking for a presales talent who is passionate about solar energy. As a presales engineer, you will be able to contribute to our customers to bring a clean, reliable and cost-effective solar energy solutions. For a more detailed information, please refer to the position description below:



Responsibilities



  • Responsible for the organization, preparation, and delivery of technical offer solutions for the bidding process.
  • Responsible for coordinating the different areas for the delivery and awarding of the bidding processes, such as engineering, finance, legal, etc.
  • Develop preliminary design documents, project costs and proposal documents for prospective projects.
  • Assist in achieving the sales target for energy storage product solutions.
  • Responsible for supporting the energy storage product solutions, technical bidding documents, etc.
  • Work closely with sales team in meeting clients, attending exhibitions and trade shows to explain energy storage product solutions.
  • Cooperate with the product development center to complete the energy storage system standardization solution for engineering productization.
  • Review and preparation of technical drawings for basic engineering (layouts, singleline diagrams, etc.)
  • Other work arranged by the leader.



Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s in industrial engineering, Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field.



Required Skills


  • Experience in an externally facing engineering role in technical sales or development of utility scale battery energy storage systems.
  • Strong techno-commercial knowledge of battery energy storage systems, including design, engineering, commissioning as well as performance guarantees.
  • Ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in different stages simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • Empathy and a customer-focused approach, with a passion for complex problem solving.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and good knowledge of other Microsoft tools like Word and PowerPoint.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Advanced Spanish (both written and spoken)
  • Familiarity with Brazilian energy market regulations, technical standards, and grid compliance requirements.
  • Experience with CAD software is a plus.

title: Devops / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure + Elixir + Linux)
description:
DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure - Elixir - Linux )


Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu node network on Microsoft Azure to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.


Your Role and Responsibilities:


  • Run Besu on Azure: manage validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, and RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.
  • Storage & performance: size and tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB) with Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimize IOPS/throughput, and implement snapshot/restore pipelines via Azure Blob Storage.
  • Networking: build secure, private networking with VNets, subnets, Azure CNI (Cilium), Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute as needed.
  • Traffic & ingress: expose RPC/WS endpoints through Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with Web Application Firewall (WAF), mTLS, rate limits, and IP allowlists.
  • Secrets & keys: manage validator keys and app secrets with Azure Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Microsoft Entra ID.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: ship immutable releases using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, ACR (image signing/scan), Helm, and Argo CD (or Flux) for environment promotion.
  • Observability & SRE: wire up Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana (or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana), OpenTelemetry traces, Alert rules, runbooks, SLOs/error budgets.


Tech You’ll Use:


  • Blockchain: Hyperledger Besu (IBFT/QBFT, permissioning);
    Geth/Nethermind familiarity is a plus
  • Elixir: Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, OpenTelemetry
  • Azure: AKS, ACR, Azure Monitor & Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana, Key Vault / Managed HSM, Application Gateway/WAF, NAT Gateway, NSG, Private Link, Azure Firewall, Blob Storage, Managed Disks (Premium v2/Ultra), Azure Backup/Site Recovery, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID
  • IaC & CI/CD: Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
  • Logging/Tracing: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK (optional), OpenTelemetry


Essential Qualifications:


  • 4+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience operating EVM nodes (preferably Besu ) and tuning storage/IO, txpool, and pruning/archive modes.
  • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
  • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).


Who We Are:


DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.


What You’ll Do


  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders;
    drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs/roadmap;
    break initiatives into epics/stories;
    manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope/out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs/screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready/Done and maintain Confluence specs/decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views/boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping;
    author PRDs/specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation/engagement/retention, run A/B experiments, and prioritize UX/performance/stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features/flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.


Reporting & rituals:


  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start/end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards/filters with Stage/Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.


Must-Haves:


  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code/PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks;
    you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.


Nice to Have:


  • Exposure to WebRTC/A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.


Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for ourproducts, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards andarchitectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled productexperiences that meet real client needs.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications,databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.G., OpenAI,Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintainingproduction applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with Javascript/Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), andPostgresQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC,GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significantimpact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it throughautomated testing, CI/CD, and observability.


Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.G.,measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse,Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, SalesforceCommunities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR/EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.


You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and weprovide mentorship and guidance as needed.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.



WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability



READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.



Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

title: Supervisor De Trade
description:
Descrição da vaga

Para nós da M. Dias Branco, a qualidade de vida no ambiente de trabalho, bem como, o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, são considerados fatores primordiais para o sucesso.


Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos e na construção de um clima organizacional favorável ao alcance dos resultados. Estamos sempre em busca de bons profissionais para integrar à nossa equipe nas mais diversas áreas e unidades.


Nossas marcas: Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras, são conhecidas nos mais diversos mercados que atuamos e levam a qualidade da M. Dias Branco para a mesa de milhões de famílias brasileiras. Cada marca ocupa uma posição de destaque em seus mercados, conquistando diversos prêmios em pesquisas junto aos consumidores.


Missão do Cargo:


Apoiar a área de Trade/Comercial, dando suporte na implementação do plano anual de atividades promocionais e de merchandising, supervisionando a sua equipe, de acordo com as diretrizes estabelecidas e com as políticas da empresa.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Supervisionar a equipe nos pontos de vendas, desenvolvendo e orientando os promotores quanto à execução e a correta utilização dos materiais de merchandising ;
  • Verificar a disposição dos produtos nas gôndolas abastecidas pelos promotores, identificando possíveis não conformidades e tomando as providências necessárias quanto aos requisitos de qualidade, padrões de arrumação pela sequência de fabricação (FIFO), fluxo de movimentação e prazos de validade dos produtos;
  • Registrar e informar a coordenação sobre ações promocionais e materiais de merchandising utilizados pela concorrência, bem como as situações extras ocorridas nos pontos de vendas, visando monitoramento e providências;
  • Prestar apoio na organização de eventos relacionados ao ponto de vendas (PDV), assegurando organização, divulgação e infraestrutura necessária para o pleno funcionamento e atendimento dos visitantes e participantes;
  • Estruturar, definir e/ou validar junto com a área comercial o plano de distribuição e roteirização para equipe de promotores, atendendo as demandas estabelecidas;
  • Separar e distribuir materiais de merchandising para as equipes de promotores e vendedores, monitorando aplicação nos pontos de venda.
  • Executar estratégias de Sell Out no canal de vendas, contribuindo para que o departamento comercial atinja as metas estabelecidas;
  • Distribuir o material necessário para a execução de ações promocionais;
  • Analisar a aderência das ações comerciais/trade e campanhas de incentivo;
  • Apresentar os resultados de campanhas de incentivo às equipes de promoção e vendas, através das reuniões periódicas;
  • Auxiliar na negociação de espaços e pontos extras com os responsáveis dos pontos de vendas;
  • Realizar atividades relacionadas a controle de recursos, benefícios, roteiros e férias dos promotores de vendas;
  • Cumprir os requisitos de segurança de alimentos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Superior em andamento em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens;
  • CNH B;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office;
  • No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.


Será um diferencial se:


  • Trade marketing;
  • Canais de distribuição;
  • Gestão de categorias;
  • Ativação no ponto de venda;
  • Estratégia de vendas.


Aqui você encontra:

- Plano de Saúde com possibilidade de incluir dependentes com condições diferenciadas.

- Plano Odontológico acessível e com possibilidade de incluir dependentes com condições diferenciadas.

- Horário Flexível*: Início da jornada entre 7h e 9h.

- Licença Paternidade Estendida: 20 dias para apoiar na chegada do novo membro da família.

- Modelo híbrido pós licença maternidade*: Iniciativa para facilitar a transição de volta ao trabalho para as colaboradoras que estão retornando da licença maternidade.

- Programa de orientação para grávidas e para o primeiro ano de vida do bebê.

- Seguro de Vida: Proteção para você e seus dependentes.

Educação - Invista no seu crescimento:

- Universidade Corporativa com programas de capacitação contínua, alinhados aos melhores métodos de aprendizagem.

- Licença não remunerada de até 12 meses uma pausa para você se dedicar ao aprendizado e desenvolvimento na sua área de atuação.

Financeiro - Benefícios que impulsionam seu bem-estar financeiro:

- Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Reconhecimento pelo alcance das metas estabelecidas.

- Previdência Privada: Possibilidade de reserva financeira com contrapartida da empresa, incentivos fiscais e opções de resgate ou renda futura.

- Cesta Básica: Disponibilizada em cartão eletrônico.

Alimentar e inspirar as pessoas, transformando sonhos em realidade

Esse é o propósito que nos inspira e faz com que sejamos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil! Reconhecida como líder nacional nos mercados de massas e biscoitos, estamos entre as maiores companhias do mundo nesses segmentos. Com quase sete décadas de existência, marcamos presença em todo o País com marcas regionais, nacionais e, agora, no Uruguai, nossa primeira aquisição internacional! Com um amplo portfólio de produtos que são sinônimos de sabor e qualidade, temos uma relação de confiança e respeito com consumidores de vários perfis.


Atuamos nos seguintes segmentos: Biscoitos de trigo e arroz;
massas de trigo e milho;
farinhas e farelos de trigo;
misturas para bolos;

bolos;

pasta de amendoim;
temperos e chocolates;
molhos, granolas;
cookies;

A partir da nossa sede, localizada na cidade de Eusébio, no Ceará, adotamos uma estratégia bem sucedida de construção e aquisição de novas indústrias. Possuímos um moderno parque industrial, com equipamentos de última geração, seguindo os mais rigorosos padrões de qualidade na produção de alimentos e operando com um modelo de integração vertical, que permite a produção de nossas mais importantes matérias-primas.


Contamos com mais de 17 mil colaboradores distribuídos em 21 unidades industriais no Brasil e 1 no Uruguai. Além disso, temos 29 centros de distribuição, estrategicamente instalados em diferentes Estados, que possibilitam a presença das nossas marcas em todo o território nacional e apoiando à exportação para mais de 40 países. Também negociamos ações no Novo Mercado da B3, bolsa de valores oficial do Brasil.


Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e ao bem comum, considerando a diversidade como o elemento mais importante para geração de resultados e mudanças significativas. Buscamos construir um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados, independentemente de idade, orientação sexual, gênero ou etnia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência, e valorizamos a autenticidade e o potencial de cada talento.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Volpi


Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas — e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática — vem com a gente!


O desafio


Estamos em busca de um Dev Fullstack Sênior para atuar no coração do nosso time de Engenharia.


Você será responsável por desenvolver e sustentar os principais serviços que suportam nosso modelo de crédito imobiliário, além de colaborar ativamente com produto, operações e parceiros externos para que a Volpi continue crescendo de forma ágil, robusta e escalável.


Aqui, você terá ownership total: vai da concepção e desenvolvimento à entrega, deploy e operação em produção.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços core da Volpi: integrações com parceiros (ex: Open Finance, bancos digitais, pagamentos), bancarização de contratos e automação de cobrança;
  • Analisar, desenhar e implementar soluções para migração de planilhas financeiras complexas para software customizado;
  • Colaborar com produto e outras áreas para entender problemas reais e entregar soluções que geram impacto no negócio;
  • Atuar na integração e adoção de plataformas CRM e iPaaS;
  • Interagir com stakeholders e parceiros externos de forma assíncrona e estruturada (Slack, RFCs, checklists, vídeos);
  • Assumir responsabilidade pelo ciclo completo do desenvolvimento — da análise à operação em produção.


O que buscamos:


  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento fullstack, com foco em backend;
  • Perfil generalista, com mentalidade full-cycle e confortável para atuar de ponta a ponta;
  • Proficiência emPython e frameworks web (Django, Flask ou FastAPI);
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL ) e não-relacionais (MongoDB );
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura, incluindo Clean Code, Design Patterns e Micro serviços;
  • Conhecimento básico em frontend (preferencialmente em Angular);
  • Experiência comdeploy e operação de aplicações em ambientes cloud-first (AWS, Render );
  • Que tenha interesse genuíno em aprender domínios complexos como crédito imobiliário e mercado financeiro;
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos end-to-end com alta qualidade técnica;
  • Interesse em aprender domínios complexos como crédito imobiliário e mercado financeiro;
  • Desejável: interesse ou experiência em tecnologias de IA, LLMs, GPTs e prompt engineering .


Nossa base tecnológica:


  • Python (Django e Flask), Postgres e MongoDB no Back-end;
  • Angular no Front-end;
  • Render, AWS, Sentry, Papertrail, Metabase, etc.


Benefícios que oferecemos:


  • Modelo 100% remoto
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
  • 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
  • Day off no aniversário
  • TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind)
  • Acesso ao Wework
  • Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo


Como é trabalhar na Volpi:


Na Volpi, vivemos nossos princípios todos os dias:

  • Atitude de Dono : você é protagonista do que entrega e do que constrói
  • Suor e Ousadia : erramos, aprendemos e melhoramos rápido
  • Dream Big, Plan Short : ambição no sonho, disciplina na execução
  • Diversidade e Colaboração : diferentes histórias e ideias nos fazem mais fortes


A Volpi acredita que times diversos e inclusivos são a base para inovação e bons resultados ! Quer fazer parte dessa transformação? Vem construir o futuro do crédito imobiliário com a gente!

description:

  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).

  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior


We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio/video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.


We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.


What You’ll Do


  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders;
    drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs/roadmap;
    break initiatives into epics/stories;
    manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope/out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs/screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready/Done and maintain Confluence specs/decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views/boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping;
    author PRDs/specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation/engagement/retention, run A/B experiments, and prioritize UX/performance/stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features/flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.


Reporting & rituals:


  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start/end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards/filters with Stage/Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.


Must-Haves:


  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code/PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks;
    you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.


Nice to Have:


  • Exposure to WebRTC/A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.
